upsets.sentence: Tampa Bay Buccaneers won 24-16 at Dallas Cowboys with a 19% market win chance.
Buffalo Bills won 37-34 at Los Angeles Rams with a 38% market win chance.
Baltimore Ravens won 30-23 at Atlanta Falcons with a 39% market win chance.

misread.sentence: The ensemble gave Dallas Cowboys 82% and Tampa Bay Buccaneers won 24-16.
The ensemble gave Atlanta Falcons 62% and Baltimore Ravens won 30-23.
The ensemble gave Los Angeles Rams 59% and Buffalo Bills won 37-34.

luckiest.sentence: Buffalo Bills: +5.8 pts of pure luck, mostly return TDs and blocked kicks (+4.6).

Detroit Lions: +4.7 pts of pure luck, mostly fumble recoveries (+3.2).

unluckiest.sentence: Los Angeles Rams: -11.0 pts of pure luck, mostly field goals and extra points (-6.4).
